summary.text: Brooklynne Mosley is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 46 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A U.S. Air Force veteran, she has worked in communications and advocacy.

paragraphs.text: Mosley was born in Kansas City, Missouri, and served in the United States Air Force until 2013.
Her career experience includes working in communications and advocacy.
Mosley took office in the Kansas House on January 13, 2025, succeeding Representative Dennis Highberger.
During the 2025-2026 session she served on the Agriculture, Corrections and Juvenile Justice, and House Federal and State Affairs committees.
